component.name: UNO Scoreboard
component.summary: Track players, rounds, and running totals for UNO matches

description.p: UNO Scoreboard helps you track players, rounds, and running totals for UNO card game matches. Add players, record each round's winner and points, and the app keeps running totals automatically until someone reaches 500 points and wins the match.

ul.li: Round-by-round score tracking with running totals
A card tally helper to quickly add up an opponent's hand
An in-app "How To Play" reference for the official UNO rules

description.p: Redesigned the Rounds table to show the round winner, points, and points remaining to 500. Added an About tab with app info, contact details, and credits.
